review_title: Sugammadex, a selective reversal medication for preventing postoperative residual neuromuscular blockade
screening_criteria: All randomized controlled trials (RCTs) on adult patients (≥ 18 years old) in which sugammadex was compared with placebo or other medications, or in which different doses of sugammadex were compared with each other. We excluded non‐randomized trials and studies on healthy volunteers.
